A.description: single coding role baseline; no decomposition review, no RAG, no QA loop

B.description: A + requirement review and architecture decomposition

C.description: B + role-level RAG over the frozen knowledge snapshot

D.description: C + QA stage with exactly one repair loop

sentinelStratification: 2 fresh (JAVA MEDIUM + TSJS) + 2 public (Java HARD + JS EASY)

missingData.infraFailure: excluded from pairwise counts but reported separately
missingData.sensitivityBounds: report best-case/worst-case paired bounds when a pair has a missing leg

statistics.perArm: Wilson 95% CI on Resolved@1, reported per slice and overall
statistics.paired: paired bootstrap percentile interval on contrast differences
statistics.multiplicity: Holm correction across the four contrasts

costAccounting.contrast: D/A cost ratio must accompany any D-A gain claim

decisionThresholds.expand: D-A fresh paired CI lower bound > 0 AND exact McNemar p < 0.05 AND missing-data sensitivity does not change the category AND sentinel re-runs do not reverse the D-A direction
decisionThresholds.strong: expand threshold met with fresh paired CI lower bound > 0
decisionThresholds.weak: direction positive but thresholds not met
